# Purpose
The provided content is a template for a pull request (PR) description used in a GitHub repository, specifically for the Gson project, which is in maintenance mode. This template guides contributors in documenting the purpose and details of their PRs, ensuring clarity and consistency. It includes sections for describing the purpose of the PR, additional details, and a checklist to verify compliance with project standards. The checklist ensures that new code adheres to the Google Java Style Guide, includes necessary documentation and tests, and passes all verification checks. This structured approach helps maintain the quality and reliability of contributions to the project.
